about: Index mapping each layer of the Recursive Symbolics Engine Architecture to concrete files and test evidence. Checked by python -m symbolics.layers.

stage.name: Collaborative Foundation
stage.meaning: Public, self-contained architecture skeleton that needs nothing from any private repository.

layers.purpose: Declare system intent and constitutional boundaries.

components.what: Machine-readable intent checked verbatim against README.md and AGENTS.md.
Contributor rules and constitutional invariants.
System refusals and where each refusal lives in code.

gaps: architecture/intent.json stays in DRAFT until ratified by a repository Maintainer.

layers.purpose: Translate intent into protocols, vocabulary, and verification standards.

components.what: Canonical symbolic operator vocabulary.
Protocol and ABC contracts (SymbolicBackend, RuleEngine, MemoryStore, ExecutionSandbox).
Independent ground truth, boundary cases, and break-it proof criteria.
Developer integration contracts for custom backends and persistent stores.
Standard-library symbolic algebra backend and RuleEngine.
Standard-library propositional logic reducer with truth-table ground truth.
Deterministic D_22 dihedral permutation solver and verification gate.

layers.purpose: Enforce constraints, depth bounds, and privacy.

components.what: The emit() firewall: caveat, tradition, source, anchors, and non-ranking filter.
Executable license duties (Articles 5.1(D), 6, 8, 9).
Approval gate: nothing an agent sends or changes outside the machine goes without a person's yes.
Scans files and patches for leaked home-folder paths.
Checked 32-bit multiplication and heap boundary guard.
CorrespondenceLedger classifying claims into VERIFIED, FAILED, or UNTESTABLE.
Single entry-point end-to-end architectural demonstration.

layers.purpose: Represent unknowns, cycle traps, and divergence explicitly.

components.what: UNTESTABLE is a first-class ledger status; all-untestable runs never pass.
AbyssException base-case breaker for non-finite and divergent trajectories.

gaps: Dynamic runtime unknowns outside registered ledgers remain local to trace logs.

layers.purpose: Provide coordinate substrates, directivity budgets, and sandboxed state.

components.what: Three-axis coordinate space and immutable Lenses.
Observable measurement layer producing addresses.
Agency budget and gamma <= 0.85 ceiling.
Transactional GGUF inspection and copy-on-write undo journal (the athanor package).
Workspace memory for agents: findings stored with the exact lines they rest on, re-checked on recall.
Architecture index & intent quotation checker.
Automated PII, path, and broken-import verification suite.
Append-only working record: what was tried, what happened, and the guard for each breach.
Checks through git history that LIBER_0.md is only ever added to.
Checks that every FAILED or CORRECTED entry names an existing guard or a reason.
Guards and accepted edits recorded beside the record, never inside it.
